sentences: EBITDA reached a record INR 643 crore, growing at 187% year-on-year and 16% quarter-on-quarter with EBITDA margin sustained at 21%.
So there, I would expect about another INR 240 crore is what we're seeing this year.
And if I was to look at next year, it would be roughly in the range of about INR 400 crore, INR 420 crore.

So just for clarification, we are estimating that in the next year, with all the assets that have been commissioned running at steady-state, we should be targeting something along the lines of about 14% to 15% EBIT.
We're confident that as demand comes in, we should be able to ramp up to beyond 100% very quickly.
I'll just mention that we are going to make, I think, about some INR 70-odd crore investment further in debottlenecking the assets to be able to touch about 4 lakh tonnes.
Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further.
So total spend will be around in the range of INR 3,200 crore.
And once we put in 25% of equity as per the bank condition of 40%, we'll start drawing from the debt.
This quarter and next quarter will be the first period where we would have pretty much 100% consumption of nitric acid.
I don't anticipate that it affects every single one of our products, maybe many of our products, 60%, 70% of our products are not as directly affected by Chinese oversupply.
So on the nitric acid investment, on the nitration and on the hydrogenation, we are expecting to run at 100% or close enough to 100% utilization from this quarter onwards.

So just within a year, our estimates of what India's domestic requirement of polycarbonate resins has changed by a factor of 50%, we are planning on coming online with this asset over the next 2, 2.5 years in an integrated fashion with propylene, phenol, BPA and then polycarbonates.

bull: H1 FY27 revenue grew 49.1% YoY to ₹5,654 crore with EBITDA expanding 196.2% to ₹1,167 crore.
Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin reached 20.4%, with net PAT surging 234.5% YoY to ₹398 crore.
Balance sheet remains conservative with net debt-to-equity ratio improving to 0.25x in Q2 FY27.
bear: Historical cash flow from operations has declined steadily from ₹874 crore in FY24 to ₹539 crore in FY26.
Borrowings increased significantly from ₹286 crore in FY24 to ₹1,638 crore in FY26.
Advanced Intermediates segment EBIT margin dropped to 6% in Q2 FY27 from 8.3% in Q1 FY27.
